finalText:
Perfect! All 40 tests now pass. **The fix:** The intermediate rounding of USD amounts after each discount was causing cent-level errors. By removing those rounding calls and rounding only once at the very end (after currency conversion), the totals now match exactly.

The bug only surfaced with non-USD currencies because the rounding errors got magnified by the exchange rates. For example, a 0.002¢ error in USD becomes ~0.0015¢ in GBP—which after rounding compounds differently than if the full precision had been maintained through all calculations.
